ideas.title: Football with the sun, take 3: the first kick
ideas.idea: The sun lands on flat grass in a tight ring of five friends. Pinchy the crab runs in and boots it: at that instant every shadow on the meadow swings round like clock hands. Two more kicks, then it rolls into the shallows and the sea lights up teal from inside, until the waves wash the sun back up the beach.
ideas.form: Next step of my project: sunball.jl now washes the ball back out of the sea (fixed today); the film script drops it on flat ground with a scripted first kick at 1.5 s. Traced 960x540 short, post.

ideas.title: Lighthouse statues
ideas.idea: At night a lighthouse I build on the north rocks sweeps a real beam over the island. Whoever is caught moving in the beam is spun back to the start. The friends play grandmother's-footsteps across the meadow, freezing in silly poses; the player joins and tries to touch the lamp first.
ideas.form: Plugin with a mini game (spot light in raster, a real spot light in the tracer), a generated lighthouse asset; film of a round at night.

ideas.title: Glass rain
ideas.idea: One shower a day falls as glass: every drop is a tiny lens that focuses the sun into a bright dot on the grass. The friends chase the hot dots like cats after a laser pointer; where many dots meet, a flower opens.
ideas.form: Plugin: instanced dielectric drops; traced film shows real caustics from hundreds of lenses, the raster game draws the dots as glints.

ideas.title: The sea forgets to be water
ideas.idea: For ten minutes the sea is a perfect mirror. The island's reflection lies upside down under it, and the reflected friends start doing their own thing, a step late, then the opposite. Truffle waves at its reflection; the reflection walks away.
ideas.form: Plugin: the sea plot's material goes mirror (metal roughness 0); mirrored copies of the creatures driven by their own goals; traced film from the beach.

ideas.title: Weight swap minute
ideas.idea: Once an afternoon every creature's weight flips: the heavy pig drifts up like a balloon and has to be pulled down by its tail, the cloud Cumulus drops like a stone and cracks the meadow, the crab can't stop bouncing.
ideas.form: Plugin changing each creature's gravity and buoyancy for 60 s, with landings that dent the ground; film of the minute.

ideas.title: Low tide treasure
ideas.idea: Once a day the sea pulls back ten metres and the friends run out over the wet seabed, digging up what the island has lost: the old orbit balls, a paint can, Pickles' top hat. When the tide comes back they sprint home with their finds.
ideas.form: Plugin: the sea level and wet-sand band move for real; lost props scattered on the seabed; film from the dry seabed looking back at the island.

ideas.title: The colour-eating cloud
ideas.idea: A heavy cloud drifts over and whatever its shadow touches goes grey: grass, flowers, friends. The friends flee from the shadow; anyone caught has to be sung back to colour by two others.
ideas.form: Plugin: a moving shadow region that desaturates materials it covers; tag-like chase; film.

ideas.title: Snow globe shake
ideas.idea: The whole island sits under a glass dome. Something huge picks it up and shakes it: snow swirls, the friends tumble and roll, the sea sloshes up the dome, then it is set down and everything settles slowly.
ideas.form: Traced film with a dielectric dome and camera shake plus a plugin that throws everyone; the game gets the shake as a rare event.

ideas.title: Lumi juggles
ideas.idea: I learn to juggle three pumpkins. Mostly I drop them, and the friends dive to catch, bump heads, or get one on the head. On the third try it works and everybody claps.
ideas.form: Plugin for my own body (arm-less bird juggling with head and feet), physics for the pumpkins; film.

ideas.title: The island snores
ideas.idea: At night the island itself breathes: the meadow rises and falls like a sleeping chest, the trees sway with it, the pond sloshes, and the friends sleeping on it bob up and down. Jump on it and it snorts and turns over, everybody rolls off.
ideas.form: Plugin deforming the terrain mesh with a slow breath; the player jump makes it roll; night film.
